entities.name: Extended rejected NSSAI
entities.description: Information element that informs the UE of one or more S-NSSAIs rejected by the network due to network slice-specific authentication and authorization failure or revocation.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that may support Extended rejected NSSAI capability.

entities.name: Access and Mobility Management Function
entities.description: Network function that may include the Extended rejected NSSAI IE to inform the UE about rejected S-NSSAIs.

entities.name: Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information
entities.description: Network slice identifiers that may be rejected due to authentication/authorization failure or revocation.

entities.name: UE supports Extended rejected NSSAI
entities.description: Condition where the UE has capability to process Extended rejected NSSAI information element.

relations.description: AMF may include Extended rejected NSSAI IE in messages to the UE
Extended rejected NSSAI IE contains information about rejected S-NSSAIs
Inclusion of Extended rejected NSSAI IE is conditional on UE support
